task.description:
Diagnose and fix the EXT-02 integration blocker reported by TEST-DESIGNER / TEST-RUNNER: webhook subscription seeding fails with AuditWriteFailed during createSubscription, preventing TC-EXT-02-INT-01..08 from completing. Determine whether the root cause is in subscription persistence, OBS-03 audit writes, transaction handling, or seeded test setup, then apply the minimal backend fix so createSubscription can succeed under integration setup and the EXT-02 integration suite can run end-to-end. Preserve prepared statements and existing API/authz behavior. Touch at most 5 source files. If the issue is actually in the test setup or fixtures rather than source code, fix that instead. Do not change the requirement spec.

REWORK ITERATION 1:
- [BLOCKER] `createSubscription` still fails with `AuditWriteFailed` after the first backend fix attempt.
- [BLOCKER] The integration suite in `tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig` can seed the admin actor, but the OBS-03 audit insert path inside `src/webhook/subscription_store.zig` still aborts the transaction.
- [BLOCKER] Compare the webhook create/delete audit transaction flow against the canonical OBS-03 contract in `src/obs/audit.zig` and the audit module design before changing behavior.
- [BLOCKER] Keep the next attempt focused on the minimal backend fix; do not expand the test scope or requirement spec.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause of AuditWriteFailed is identified and fixed
EXT-02 integration setup can seed subscriptions successfully
